cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a hangar maintenance bay — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a futuristic orbital hydroponic fruit orchard — she rests after carrying a basket of spare fruit for the crew; an open pavilion floating above a sea of clouds at sunrise — standing; a museum hands-on workshop table before opening — sips a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw through the straw; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — standing; a modern planetarium outreach corner after a show — she playfully demonstrates a star-map fold for visitors off camera; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a wooden sauna and cold plunge with a cooling lounge — holds a towel folded against her chest; a sunny beach with wet sand and shallow surf — chest-deep in the water; a pilot ready room beside a hangar — lifts a small hand lantern to chest height; a neighbourhood café with a counter and window seats — holds a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw at chest height; overgrown jungle temple ruins — kneeling on the ground; the Wuhou Shrine in Chengdu — holds a white feather fan in both hands in front of her chest
